title: NPC行为异常
description: NPC出现异常行为，包括无故死亡、随机登上玩家飞船、偷取物品、自杀、卡住等，影响游戏进程和体验。
evidence: I haven’t been able to reliably play with an NPC crew member aboard my ship because of how unstable that system currently feels
having weird nameless NPCs just appear in the back of my ship for no reason
characters never waking up from sleeping just completely ruins the game

evidence_items.quote: it's also still held together with duct tape and baling wire, particularly where NPC's are concerned
evidence_items.description: NPC相关部分仍然不稳定，像用胶带和铁丝勉强拼凑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它仍然是用胶带和捆扎铁丝勉强拼凑在一起的，尤其是在涉及NPC的地方

evidence_items.quote: NPCs still just randomly kill themselves around the stations if they have access to a suit
evidence_items.description: NPC在有宇航服的情况下仍会在空间站周围随机自杀。
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC们仍然会在空间站周围随机自杀，只要他们能拿到宇航服

evidence_items.quote: there was a bug which made random npcs come onto your ship and using your stuff
evidence_items.description: 一个bug导致随机NPC登上玩家飞船并使用玩家的物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一个bug会让随机NPC来到你的船上并使用你的东西

evidence_items.quote: I haven’t been able to reliably play with an NPC crew member aboard my ship because of how unstable that system currently feels
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我一直无法可靠地在我的船上与NPC船员一起游玩，因为该系统目前感觉非常不稳定

evidence_items.quote: characters never waking up from sleeping just completely ruins the game
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色睡觉后再也醒不过来，这完全毁了这个游戏

evidence_items.quote: station personel dropping like flies if you stick around for a few hours, leaving their valuables behind
evidence_items.description: 空间站人员会在几小时内大量死亡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你在空间站待上几个小时，空间站人员就会像苍蝇一样纷纷倒下，留下他们的贵重物品

evidence_items.quote: NPCs steal your items? Items disappearing? Had to reload as a core item like my helmet disappeared.
evidence_items.description: NPC偷物品或物品消失，核心物品如头盔消失需重载
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC会偷你的物品？物品会消失？我不得不重新加载，因为像我的头盔这样的核心物品消失了。

evidence_items.quote: having weird nameless NPCs just appear in the back of my ship for no reason
evidence_items.description: 无名NPC无故出现在飞船后部
evidence_items.quote_zh: 奇怪的匿名NPC无缘无故就出现在我飞船的后部
